# superset_saved_query (Resource)

Manages a query saved in SQL Lab.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_saved_query" "daily_signups" {
  database_id         = superset_database.analytics.id
  label               = "Daily signups"
  description         = "Signups per day, parameterised by date"
  schema              = "public"
  sql                 = "SELECT count(*) FROM signups WHERE day = '{{ day }}'"
  template_parameters = jsonencode({ day = "2026-01-01" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (Number) Identifier of the database connection the query runs against.
- `label` (String) Name of the saved query as shown in SQL Lab.
- `sql` (String) The SQL text.

### Optional

- `catalog` (String) Default catalog the query runs in. Only Superset 4.1 and later support catalogs.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the query.
- `schema` (String) Default schema the query runs in.
- `template_parameters` (String) JSON object with the Jinja template parameters of the query.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the saved query.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A saved query is imported by its numeric id.
terraform import superset_saved_query.daily_signups 9
```
